speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Brother. I came for the horses, not for a reading. Hobbins's grey is sound. The mare in the string wants a shoe, and she will not get it from a haberdasher.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: She will get it before I load her. Twopence the letter, Master Shakespeare, sixpence the parcel, and nothing for what you shout after me. Have you a letter, or have you a family?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A letter. Twopence. Here. It is the Sunday sheet, and it is not a parcel. Gilbert, the felt in Fleet Street will not rise if you stay to hear Stratford. I would rather you did not.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Then I will not. Short of a fire, you can have your yard to yourself. Brother. Hobbins, buy the grey if anyone is buying. I am not buying.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Nobody is buying. Go and price your buttons. The mare and I understand each other.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Buttons, then. I have not seen your sheet, Will, and I am not going to loiter until I have.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Go.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Now. I have one for you, and I have taken yours. Read it in the yard if you mean to read it. The light is going, and the grey does not like a man who weeps into a pack-saddle.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not going to weep into your saddle. The hand is Anne's, or it is Susanna's at her dictation. I am leaving that open. The groats came nine days late, and they were spent inside the hour.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Nine days is the road in this weather, and an hour is a house with children. I carry the money. I do not sit on it to improve it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Judith bought a ballad she cannot read. She made her sister say it over until she had it. She sings it at the wash. Hamnet bought a whistle, and he lent the odd penny to a boy who has not paid. She writes that it makes him my father's grandson.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A whistle and a bad debt. I can carry the news of that without a sermon. What of your father? You asked the road with your face before you asked with your mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cough is gone. That is in the sheet, in the hand I am not deciding. I had mending. I have gone. I will take gone.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Gone is a good word on a wet yard. Read the rest standing. If you sit, the ostler will bring you ale, and ale turns a letter into a visit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Of my coming she says, come then, she shall believe the horse when she hears it. She does not ask me to swear a day I have not sent.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Good news, master?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Just news. It's rarer.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Rarer than good. I will remember the phrase the next time a man wants me to smile at a cheese. Is there more, lower down? You have gone quick, and quick is how a man skips a bill.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a sentence in a different ink. I have read it. I am putting it away. It is not for the yard, and it is not for a reckoning in Carter Lane. You have the twopence. You have the Sunday sheet. That is the whole of our trade today.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twopence taken, and the sheet in the bag. I can carry a letter. I cannot make her read what you meant instead of what you wrote. You said that to yourself on the road, I expect. I say it to you here for nothing, which is against my habit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Against your habit, and true. The day is still not in it. She will believe the horse when she hears it. I laughed because she is right, and I am putting the other sentence away because it can wait without your horses listening.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: The horses listen to oats. I listen to pence. We are square. If your brother asks me what the letter said, I shall tell him the grey is sound. I was hired to carry, not to report.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tell him the grey is sound. Tell him nothing else. I am going home. The yard has had all the news it is getting, and the news is just news.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Just news, and twopence, and a mare that wants a shoe. I can carry three true things easier than one dressed one. God keep you on the walk home. The grey and I are for the road when she is shod.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you, on the road. The sheet is yours. The other sentence is staying in my hand, and it is not becoming a message for the mare.
